title: Integrated analysis of network pharmacology and multi-omics reveals the mechanisms of Zuogui Jiangtang Qinggan formula ameliorates MASLD via fatty acid metabolic reprogramming.
authors: Zou, Junju; Dai, Yuwei; Yu, Yungfeng; Wu, Yongjun; Xiang, Qin; Yu, Rong
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方对代谢相关脂肪肝病的疗效机制，核心为代谢通路与脂肪酸代谢重编程，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模，亦无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The global prevalence of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) continues to rise, and its pathogenesis is complex, creating an urgent need to discover novel and effective therapeutic strategies. The Zuogui Jiangtang Qinggan formula (ZGJTQGF), an approved in-hospital preparation, has demonstrated significant clinical efficacy in treating diabetes over several decades. However, the mechanisms underlying its potential therapeutic effects on MASLD remain unclear PURPOSE: This study systematically investigates the therapeutic effects and molecular mechanisms of ZGJTQGF on MASLD through the integration of network pharmacology and multi-omics strategies. METHODS: The model of MASLD was successfully induced in db/db mice by a high-fat diet (HFD), which displayed characteristic dyslipidaemia. Serum biomarkers, histology, and hepatic multi-omics analyses were employed to assess metabolic status, steatosis, targets, and pathways. Ultraperformance liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (UPLC-MS/MS), molecular docking analysis and in vitro verification were applied to explore the active ingredients of ZGJTQGF. RESULTS: ZGJTQGF significantly reduced dyslipidemia in HFD-fed mice, inhibited pro-inflammatory cytokines, and restored glucose metabolic balance by lowering levels of glucose, insulin, OGTT, and HOMA-IR. Histopathology showed reduced lipid deposition and hepatocyte damage. Comprehensive multi-omics analysis suggested that regulating the AMPK/PGC-1alpha/PPARalpha and FXR-BSEP signaling pathways could be potential targets for ZGJTQGF in reprogramming glucose and lipid metabolism in MASLD treatment. Blood component analysis identified 52 ZGJTQGF-derived compounds. In molecular docking experiments, Wogonin, Naringenin, Quercetin, Tanshinone IIA and Berberine showed high-affinity binding to core targets in AMPK, PPARalpha, PGC-1alpha, FXR and FAS. Mechanistically, ZGJTQGF activated AMPK/PPARalpha /PGC-1alpha and FXR-BSEP signaling pathway, promotes fatty acid beta oxidation and enhances energy consumption in AML-2 and 3T3-L1 cells, downregulates SREBP-1-dependent adipogenesis (reduces ACC1 and FAS expression), alleviates MASLD driven reprogramming of glucose and lipid metabolism, and regulates lipid metabolism and fatty acid synthesis. CONCLUSIONS: ZGJTQGF activates the AMPK/PPARalpha /PGC-1alpha pathway and inhibits abnormal lipid accumulation in diabetic fatty liver by promoting fatty acid beta-oxidation, energy consumption, and bile acid metabolism. These findings provide new insights into the mechanism of ZGJTQGF in the treatment of diabetic fatty liver disease.
abstract_zh: 背景：代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病（MASLD）的全球患病率持续上升，其发病机制复杂，迫切需要发现新颖有效的治疗策略。左归降糖清肝方（ZGJTQGF）是一种已批准的院内制剂，在治疗糖尿病方面数十年来显示出显著的临床疗效。然而，其对MASLD潜在治疗作用的机制仍不清楚。目的：本研究通过整合网络药理学和多组学策略，系统探讨ZGJTQGF对MASLD的治疗效果及分子机制。方法：通过高脂饮食（HFD）成功诱导db/db小鼠MASLD模型，该模型表现出特征性血脂异常。采用血清生物标志物、组织学及肝脏多组学分析评估代谢状态、脂肪变性、靶点和通路。应用超高效液相色谱-串联质谱（UPLC-MS/MS）、分子对接分析和体外验证探索ZGJTQGF的活性成分。结果：ZGJTQGF显著减轻HFD喂养小鼠的血脂异常，抑制促炎细胞因子，并通过降低葡萄糖、胰岛素、OGTT和HOMA-IR水平恢复葡萄糖代谢平衡。组织病理学显示脂质沉积和肝细胞损伤减少。综合多组学分析提示，调节AMPK/PGC-1alpha/PPARalpha和FXR-BSEP信号通路可能是ZGJTQGF在MASLD治疗中重编程葡萄糖和脂质代谢的潜在靶点。血液成分分析鉴定出52种ZGJTQGF来源化合物。在分子对接实验中，Wogonin、Naringenin、Quercetin、Tanshinone IIA和Berberine与AMPK、PPARalpha、PGC-1alpha、FXR和FAS中的核心靶点表现出高亲和力结合。机制上，ZGJTQGF激活AMPK/PPARalpha/PGC-1alpha和FXR-BSEP信号通路，促进脂肪酸β氧化并增强AML-2和3T3-L1细胞的能量消耗，下调SREBP-1依赖性脂肪生成（降低ACC1和FAS表达），缓解MASLD驱动的葡萄糖和脂质代谢重编程，并调节脂质代谢和脂肪酸合成。结论：ZGJTQGF通过促进脂肪酸β氧化、能量消耗和胆汁酸代谢，激活AMPK/PPARalpha/PGC-1alpha通路并抑制糖尿病性脂肪肝中的异常脂质积累。这些发现为ZGJTQGF治疗糖尿病性脂肪肝病的机制提供了新见解。
